name: fault dislocation
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 断层两侧发生的相对位移。
usage_overview: 在穿越活动断裂带的隧道及轨道结构响应分析中，作为引起结构变形的外部作用；数值模拟可通过施加位移边界条件表示断层两侧的相对运动。

complete_examples.text: In this section, two models are integrated together to study the response of track structure to fault dislocation.
CRTS III is 19.48% ~ 36.29% of that in P-PRBT under the same fault dislocation displacement.
